Choosing an agency24 October 20262 min

Web agency in Marseille, Oran or Constantine: should you choose one near you?

Many companies look for a “web agency near me”. Proximity helps, but it is not the main criterion. Here is what really matters.

The Codex teamSoftware studio, Marseille · since 2014
03

Contents0 %

  1. 01What proximity brings
  2. 02What matters more
  3. 03Working remotely with an agency
  4. 04And local SEO?
  5. 05How Codex works

Share

In short

  • Proximity makes workshops easier, but a project can be run very well remotely.
  • The real criteria: delivered projects, working method and follow-up after delivery.
  • For local SEO, the agency must master Google Business Profile.

When searching for “web agency Marseille”, “web agency Oran” or “website design Constantine”, people think of proximity first. It has real advantages, but it guarantees neither quality nor deadlines.

01What proximity brings

  • in-person scoping workshops, easier for a complex project;
  • better knowledge of your local market;
  • the chance to meet the team and visit its premises.

02What matters more

The criteria that make a project succeed are the same everywhere: delivered, verifiable projects, a clear method with approvals at each stage, a single point of contact and follow-up after launch. We detail them in our guide to choosing the best development agency in France.

03Working remotely with an agency

Today, most web projects are run remotely: video meetings, mock-ups shared online, regular demos and a progress tool accessible at any time. A company in Oran or Constantine can work with an agency in Marseille as effectively as with a neighbouring one, provided the method is clear.

Distance does not matter: what matters is seeing the project move forward every week.

The Codex team

04And local SEO?

If your customers search “near me”, your website and your Google Business Profile must be optimised for your city. A good agency knows these levers wherever it is located: pages per service and per city, identical contact details everywhere, customer reviews. See our guide to SEO in France.

05How Codex works

Codex is based in Marseille and supports companies in all of France and abroad, on site or remotely, with offices in Doha and Marseille. Every project starts with a scoping workshop, then moves forward in phases with regular demos. Discover our website design service.

Codex’s advice

Whether the agency is close or not, ask to see a project in progress: how approvals are organised, and how often you will see progress.

Our serviceWebsite designFast, secure and well-ranked business websites, online shops and web platforms.

FAQ

Your questions on this topic

Another question? Write to us, we reply quickly.

Should I choose a web agency in my city?

It is not essential. Proximity makes workshops easier, but the quality of delivered projects, the working method and the follow-up after delivery matter more.

Can an agency in Marseille work with a company in Oran or Constantine?

Yes. Projects run very well remotely with video meetings, shared mock-ups and regular demos, complemented by on-site meetings when needed.

How can I be visible locally on Google?

With a complete Google Business Profile, identical contact details on your website and in directories, pages adapted to your city and customer reviews.
